text:
raj: t-minus 45 for EU midnight change window. quick status: any freeze exemptions still outstanding? need final go/no-go by +30.

deploy-bot: Canary pinned: model-server v3.7.1 -> euc1-canary-2. Health: ✅ 200/200 p95 120ms. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/canary/1749876543

olivia: release notes? posting link: https://confluence.redwood.example/display/RELEASES/v3.7.1 :eyes:

sam: checklist: smoke tests ✅, migrations dry-run ✅, infra warmup at 60% (autoscaler ramping). will post smoke logs in 2m.

sam: ```
# quick smoke
kubectl --context=staging rollout status deploy/model-server
curl -sS http://euc1-canary-2/health || true
```

emily: rollback owners: raj -> overall decision, sam -> execute rollback, olivia -> migrations revert. oncall will page if >2% error. :rotating_light:

raj: if canary error >1% we abort. sam - confirm rollback command ready?

sam: ready. rollback command:
```
deployctl rollback --service model-server --to v3.7.0 --force
```
I tested it in staging earlier today.

deploy-bot: 1749876600 Canary health update: error rate 0.9% (≈10 err/min), p95 125ms — within threshold. tail: /var/log/canary/requests.log

olivia: not seeing migration warnings in logs, good. :thumbsup:

raj: OK starting gradual traffic shift. deploy-bot start 10% -> 50% over 12m.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift started: 10% -> 50% over 12m. Alert thresholds: error>1% OR p95>250ms. Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/changes

emily: if latency spikes we pause and roll back. i'll watch metrics + db locks.

oncall-bot: quiet window active. no non-emergency changes allowed until +4h. infra reminder: confirm autoscaler cap and instance warm pool.

sam: posted final release note to #release-notes. cc legal.

raj: thanks team. last call for exceptions?

olivia: none from me.

deploy-bot: Traffic 30% — p95 130ms — errors 0.7%.

raj: good. keep watching. i'll update the change-window doc and ping once we reach 50%.
